name: Before You Reply
description: Ten gentle ideas to try before answering a message or comment.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Ten cards for pausing before you reply, shown on Calm Cards.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Read a card or two and go back to your day.
howToPlay: Read the idea on the card.
Press Show more for a little more detail.
Try it, or press Next for something different.
tips: These are ideas, not rules. Reply in whatever way feels right to you.
